programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Madrangi
programme.desc: Deepu, the daughter of a rich businessman, falls in love with her driver Manu. Problems arise when Manu suffers a brain injury and is blamed for the death of an MLA's brother.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Asmaan Se Ooncha
programme.desc: Inspector Malik transfers to Mumbai along with his family and sets out on a mission to catch King, an underworld leader. However, a shocking revelation changes the course of their lives.

programme.title: Kab? Kyoon? Aur Kahan?
programme.desc: Asha, a rich man's daughter, is arrested for her uncle's murder. Inspector Anand, who loves her, tries his best to solve the case and save her.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Jadugar Ki Kahar
programme.desc: Bollywood drama starring Devaraj, 2009.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Anokhi Ada
programme.desc: Lalaji and Gupta, two business partners, take their relationship to the next level when their children, Rakesh and Neeta, marry each other. However, chaos ensues when Lalaji helps Gopal, a stranger.

programme.title: Naya Din Nayi Raat
programme.desc: Sushma, a young girl, runs away from home to escape an arranged marriage. On her way, she meets many people, each representing a distinct facet of human nature, who help her in her difficulties.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
programme.desc: Honest and upright, Inspector Arjun is very different from his happy-go-lucky younger brother Ajit. Their relationship hits rocky ground after Ajit is accused of murder.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.desc: S1 E46 — Dogs With JobsMum takes Maddie and Triggs to the dog park. On the way, they encounter Lolo, a new friend. Lolo is a guide dog and teaches them what it means to be a working dog with a special job.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: S1 E33 — Fine Forest Gift TreeWilf asks the Piggies to build a vehicle with a big basket - he wants to use it to steal all the gifts at the Fine Forest party! The Piggies must get them back.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: S4 E15 — HeistCan Sixteen to Twenty use their special skills to sneak past the robot guards at the Museum of Numbers? Learn about the special properties of numbers with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: S3 E24 — AntsA, N and T sit down for a nice picnic, but soon everyone is getting tickled, the food starts disappearing and N gets the blame.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: S11 E13 — We're All Friends: DentistJustin and his friend go to the dentist for a check-up. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble pretends to be a dentist for his toy patients.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S1 E40 — BalletDipsy ballet twirls with the Tiddlytubbies and the children in Tummy Tales put on a ballet show for their family at home.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: S1 E12 — The Zebras Get Some ExerciseThe zebras get some exercise. Hamza visits the watering hole and goes on an elephant walk.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: S5 E8 — Monster GrumpMolly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack's stall. She chooses the tub of blue slimy stuff and remembers the day she got it. Caitlin is in her new den, but she's in a bit of a grump and doesn't want to share it with anyone. When Euan, Ruby and Ayesha try to get in, she becomes an even bigger grump. Ruby has dropped a book about monsters and this gives Caitlin an idea - she's going to pretend her den has a monster to scare the others away!

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: S1 E17 — Rail MachinesMotorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that run on rails. Grace helps drive a tram that can go up a very big hill, shows off a monorail and is a co-driver in a high-speed train.

programme.title: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Waffle's Keepy UppyThe After Schoolers play keepy uppy with balloons. Mrs Hobbs is very competitive, but it's Waffle who's the champ, keeping the last balloon up with a perfectly timed bottom bounce.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: S2 E16 — Baby CukeGinger and the baby Pea-Rexes help a lost Baby Cuke back to its herd, but the teething Cuke's incessant need to suck makes the process more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: The Octonauts and the Beetle InvasionWhen a group of bombardier beetles are forced from their home by rising sea levels, they attempt to settle on a new island but discover that it is already inhabited by hungry frogs and spiders.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S2 — The Tale of Jeremy Fisher's RecitalWhen Sammy Whiskers and Mr Tod crash Jeremy Fisher's annual lake-side get together, it's up to Peter to save the party.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S1 E14 — The Food Growing BadgeDuggee is sowing seeds. The squirrels ask if they can grow something too. One of the squirrels is in for an enormous surprise.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S1 E15 — The Paddling Pool BadgeIt's a scorcher of a day. Luckily Duggee has a big paddling pool. Yippee. First, they need help with blowing up the pool and filling it with water. Thank goodness for Ethel the elephant, she can do everything.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: S4 E3 — Jud and Lucas Become FriendsIt's a new day, and Mrs Farrell is checking in with all the children to see how they are. Lucas tells her he is looking for more friends to play with, and there are lots of volunteers. Isla, Otto and Jud bake some delicious tiger ginger biscuits, using coloured icing for roar-some decorations. At playtime, Jud asks if she can play with Lucas, and they have a fun-filled game of chase. The day ends with carpet-time, and Lucas is happy with his new-found friends.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: S3 E26 — Veggie MagicWhen Evil Pea poses as a magician so that she can use magic tricks to make the Tato Team 'disappear', Supertato and Carrot create their own magical plan to rescue them.

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Mission CheerleadingWeasy turns into an unbearable coach when the ducklings lose a race against the eaglets.

programme.title: Do Not Watch This Show
programme.desc: S1 E7 — SleepWizz just wants to go to sleep, but Mr Goblin has cursed him to stay awake.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E41 — StickbirdOn a trip to the beach, Mum teaches Bluey how to throw. Bingo and Dad get creative with a funny shaped stick.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E4 — SquashWhen Dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo pretend that they are in control of their every move. Bingo proves that big siblings don't always beat little siblings.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Zog's Taxi ServiceGadabout and Pearl need Zog's help to catch a stink beetle for an urgent cure. Little do they know, Zog has become a taxi for the gnomes.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Stick InsectMiss Collie brings her pet stick insect, Woody, to class, but halfway through the day, Woody mysteriously vanishes. Dodge, Woofer, and Jazz spring into action, convinced a pup has taken him, and launch an investigation to track down the culprit.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: S3 E5 — Waffle's School WalkiesIt's the morning of Evie's first day at school and the Brooklyn-Bells are on schedule. But Waffle isn't happy. He's expecting his usual morning walkies. Doug tells Waffle that Gramps will be walking him today, he'll be coming to the house later. Waffle is insistent, he wants to walk to school with the rest of the family.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: The Do-It-All WishRafi's wish to do it all causes chaos, teaching her one task at a time works best.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: S1 E21 — Summer: It's Time to Pick StrawberriesAfter going strawberry picking at the local strawberry farm, JoJo and Gran Gran have lots of juicy strawberries left over. They're too full to eat them, but Gran Gran has a plan! JoJo helps Gran Gran make delicious strawberry jam.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: S3 E5 — Train FudgeSarah and Duck take an unexpected train trip whilst on their quest to buy some fudge.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: S1 E51 — Building BridgesThe new table Major has made collapses, spilling soup everywhere. Tiny and Small are sent off to fetch some more soup, but the soup trolley crashes into a new bump in the path on the way to the soup wells. Major finds a new use for his collapsed table.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: S1 E37 — TutuMemo and Baba play dress up.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: S2 E17 — Tombliboo Ooo Brings the Ball IndoorsThe Tombliboos are playing inside when they hear a ball outdoors. Ooo collects the ball and brings it inside, and the Tombliboos play with the ball indoors until it flies out of the window.

programme.title: Cbeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: S2025A different story read by a special guest each night just before bedtime.

programme.title: Villages by the Sea
programme.desc: S4 E3 — CushendallBen Robinson travels to Cushendall, one of the finest planned Georgian villages in Northern Ireland. It was owned and shaped by a series of owners but most notably its 19th-century merchant landlord Francis Turnly.

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: S4 E1 — Sheffield to KeadbyRobbie Cumming begins his 300-mile boating adventure across the north of England and the Midlands. He is forced to make a running repair to his narrowboat, the Naughty Lass, while on the Tinsley lock flight in South Yorkshire, he cruises beneath Conisbrough's magnificent viaduct and must wait for an unusual sliding railway bridge to open on the Stainforth and Keadby Canal.

programme.title: Remembers...
programme.desc: Simon Sebag Montefiore Remembers... Rome: A History of the Eternal CityFamous names from both sides of the camera reflect on making some of the most popular and influential programmes of all time.

programme.title: Rome: A History of the Eternal City
programme.desc: S1 E1 — City of the SacredHistorian Simon Sebag Montefiore uncovers the central role played by religion in creating and maintaining the power of the city of Rome from its foundations to the modern day. In the first episode we see how every event in ancient Rome revolved around religion. From the foundation myth through to the deification of Emperors, nothing could happen without calling upon the Pantheon of Roman gods.

programme.title: Mary Beard's Ultimate Rome: Empire Without Limit
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Episode 3Mary Beard delves into the question of identity and citizenship within the Roman Empire. She explores how different parts of the empire reacted to Roman rule. In the beautifully preserved cities of Algeria, incomers and locals created flourishing communities with a distinct 'more Roman than Rome' frontier identity.

programme.title: I, Claudius
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Reign of TerrorSejanus wants to marry Livilla following his divorce, but Tiberius refuses permission and suggests Helen. This enrages Livilla, who poisons Helen.

programme.title: I, Claudius
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Zeus, by Jove!When Tiberius dies, the insane Caligula becomes emperor, and, as if we haven't seen enough blood, the trouble really starts! Caligula announces that he and his sister have become gods, and demands that Lentulus makes good his offer of sacrifice.

programme.title: The Australian Wars
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Episode 1The story of Australia's first wars, calling for the nation to acknowledge the First Peoples who died in these conflicts and for the Australian War Memorial to recognise them.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: S1 E8 — OrangeLive from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the daring Orange attempting to cross the stage on a tightrope, if she manages to ignore any distractions.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S1 E7 — FrogBing finds a frog in the garden and wants to keep it, so he and Sula make the frog a house in a bucket. But Froggy doesn't like her new home and hops out. Maybe they've not thought enough about what Froggy really needs in her home.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S2 E15 — Sliding DownThe Tubby Car takes the Teletubbies to the Hidey Hup where they discover the Tubby Slidey. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po have great fun sliding down again and again.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: S2 E20 — OutsideIt's a lovely sunny day, but Tee wants to stay inside. Mo tries to persuade him to come out and play by showing him videos of some of the outside fun they've had.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: S2 E14 — A Colourful JourneyThe Colourblocks travel through Colourland on an airship, picking up new and old friends along the way. They reminisce about all the amazing things they've learnt on their colour journey.

programme.title: Bluey Minisodes
programme.desc: S1 E4 — LetterNana reads an old story that Bandit wrote from when he was five. The kids find this hilarious as Nana is reading out the words exactly as they are spelt.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S2 E12 — NamesPando is at Bing's house today and has an earworm called Bingly Bangly. Bing isn't impressed with this, declaring that he is Bing. When Pando can't resist saying the name, Bing knocks Pando's tower over and wants him to go home. But then Flop suggests they try a 'Thingly song' instead.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Pirate ParadeMojo and Bo fix Ted up as a pirate ship for the Pirate Parade, but swashbuckling Cap'n Dot hijacks him. Team Mojo must out-pirate Dot and sail the streets to stop her.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E8 — The Kite BadgeIt's a very windy day and the Squirrels want to play outside. Duggee knows what to do, he's flying his kite. The Squirrels make their own kites to fly.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E9 — The Tadpole BadgeDuggee has made a beautiful rock pool, a place of calm for all the animals. The Squirrels spot dots with tails, wriggling around. They are baby frogs, tadpoles.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E42 — Show And TellBluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around when she doesn't get what she wants.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E5 — HairdressersBluey and Bingo play a game of hairdressers, catering to Mum and all her needs. Then Dad comes along for a haircut, too, and Bluey and Bingo are surprised to discover that he has lice.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: S2 E30 — The Boreal Forest, CanadaGrandmaster Glitch's Grimbots really need some cuddles, so it's down to Glitch to find them a new teddy bear! Glitch knows that bears live in Ontario in Canada, so he heads there to try and find a nice cuddly bear. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters are also in Canada competing in the Ontario lumberjack championships.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S3 — The Tale of the Saving of the ShrewWith his father's journal and the help of his best friends Benjamin and Lily, Peter is ready for some fun and delightful new discoveries.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: S1 E3 — The Crab and UrchinCaptain Barnacles and Kwazii investigate a disruption on a nearby reef: a carrier crab and the urchin who lives on its shell just can't seem to get along.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: S5 E18 — Too Many ThreesThree's attempts to hide in the Clubhouse get increasingly tricky in a slapstick comedy of Threes. Learn which numbers are multiples of three, with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S4 — The Reading SongA nice and fun song that is all about the joys and magic of reading.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Penguin GamesWhen Millie the Squid devises a set of tough penguin games to test the Piripenguins, Pancake and Nugget must stick together and rely on their friendship to succeed.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: S1 E14 — Twiggy's Tummy AcheTwiggy has a funny tummy on the day of his performance. Nothing the doctors try works, not even the cure for froggy moths! Zog wonders if there is something else bothering Twiggy.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E34 — Ready, Sheddy, GoNori and Dot are stuck in a tree house without a door. How can Mojo and Bo get them out? By sending the treehouse flying across town, that's how!

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: A repressed ballet dancer leads a sheltered life, devoted entirely to her art. She pursues the lead role in a production of Swan Lake, but the director convinces her she will only be capable of dancing the part if she embraces her darker impulses. This leads her into a destructive relationship with a rival that threatens her sanity. Drama, starring an Oscar-winning Natalie Portman. With Mila Kunis, Vincent Cassel and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: (500) Days of Summer
programme.desc: A greetings card employee looks back on his relationship with the woman he loves, after she has seemingly left him for good. As he recalls the key events of the 500 days he knew her, the ups and downs of their romance are presented in random order. Romantic comedy, starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Zooey Deschanel.

programme.title: Pocahontas
programme.desc: A Native American princess falls in love with an English settler, but her father is distrustful of the Europeans - not without just cause, as a cruel governor is prepared to wage war to get his hands on the gold he believes they are hiding. Animated drama, with the voices of Irene Bedard, Mel Gibson and Christian Bale.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: A princess defies her mother's plans to secure peace by marrying her off to the son of one of their allies. A witch provides the rebellious royal with a magic spell to change her fate, but the enchantment backfires disastrously when the queen is transformed into a bear. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

programme.title: Pocahontas
programme.desc: A Native American princess falls in love with an English settler, but her father is distrustful of the Europeans - not without just cause, as a cruel governor is prepared to wage war to get his hands on the gold he believes they are hiding. Animated drama, with the voices of Irene Bedard, Mel Gibson and Christian Bale.

programme.title: Cars 2
programme.desc: Racing car Lightning McQueen heads overseas to compete in an international grand prix, with events in Britain, Japan and Italy. He gets mixed up in international espionage when a case of mistaken identity leads to an encounter with two English spy cars searching for a powerful gadget. Pixar animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Owen Wilson and Michael Caine.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Two monsters work for an energy firm that employs scary creatures to sneak into children's bedrooms and convert their screams into power. However, when a little girl accidentally wanders into the pair's domain, they have to race against time to return her safely home before anyone finds out. Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

programme.title: The Lion King
programme.desc: After the murder of his father Mufasa, young lion prince Simba flees his African kingdom, only to learn the true meaning of responsibility and bravery as he clashes with his wicked uncle Scar. Director Jon Favreau's animated remake of Disney's 1994 blockbuster, featuring the voices of Donald Glover, Beyonce Knowles and Seth Rogen.

programme.title: Mary Poppins Returns
programme.desc: In 1930s London, Michael Banks lives in his family home with his children, Annabel, John, and Georgie. Still grieving the death of his wife, and behind on loan payments, his house is due to be repossessed unless he comes up with the money soon. Thankfully, help comes in the form of the practically perfect nanny who returns 25 years after her previous visit. Musical fantasy, starring Emily Blunt, Dick Van Dyke and Meryl Streep.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: The struggling owner of a run-down gym is forced to take drastic action to prevent an arrogant fitness guru buying the business out from under him - and enlists his customers to form a dodgeball team in the hope of triumphing in the US championships. Sporting comedy, starring Ben Stiller, Vince Vaughn and Christine Taylor.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honour their beloved grandmother. Comedy drama, starring an Oscar and Bafta-winning Kieran Culkin, and Jesse Eisenberg, who also directed and won a Bafta for Best Original Screenplay.

programme.title: Nightbitch
programme.desc: A nameless stay-at-home Mother tends to her young son in the suburbs while Husband casually goes out to work. Trapped in a whirlpool of rage and frustration about the loss of her identity, Mother becomes convinced that she is turning into one of the dogs that roam the neighbourhood. Dark comedy adapted from Rachel Yoder's novel, starring Amy Adams and Scoot McNairy.

programme.title: Bad Company
programme.desc: A secret agent is murdered, leaving his veteran CIA partner to transform the dead man's streetwise twin from an uncouth hustler into a credible replacement for his brother, so the agency can continue its investigation into a diabolical terrorist plot involving a nuclear bomb. Comedy thriller, starring Anthony Hopkins, Chris Rock, Peter Stormare, Gabriel Macht and John Slattery.

programme.title: National Treasure
programme.desc: An intrepid treasure-hunter follows a series of ingenious clues in a perilous quest to track down a war chest hidden by America's founding fathers generations before. He has to contend with determined rivals in the shape of a treacherous associate and the FBI. Action adventure, starring Nicolas Cage, Diane Kruger, Sean Bean and Justin Bartha.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

programme.title: George of the Jungle
programme.desc: An American heiress on holiday in Africa gets stranded in the wilderness, but is rescued by a primitive man who was raised by apes. When her cruel fiancee takes her back to the States, the besotted king of the jungle follows, but is unprepared for modern living. Comedy based on the TV cartoon series, starring Brendan Fraser, Leslie Mann, Thomas Haden Church and Richard Roundtree.

programme.title: Ratatouille
programme.desc: A rat finds his love of fine food has made him an outcast to his less discerning family. Separated from his fellow rodents by a storm, he winds up in a famous French restaurant, where he helps an incompetent kitchen assistant become the greatest chef in Paris. Animated comedy from the director of The Incredibles, with the voices of Patton Oswalt, Ian Holm, Lou Romano and Peter O'Toole.

programme.title: Mary Poppins Returns
programme.desc: In 1930s London, Michael Banks lives in his family home with his children, Annabel, John, and Georgie. Thankfully, help comes in the form of the practically perfect nanny who returns 25 years after her previous visit. Musical fantasy, starring Emily Blunt, Dick Van Dyke and Meryl Streep.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: A princess defies her mother's plans to secure peace by marrying her off to the son of one of their allies. A witch provides the rebellious royal with a magic spell to change her fate, but the enchantment backfires disastrously when the queen is transformed into a bear. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Maleficent
programme.desc: A fairy falls in love with an ambitious human nobleman, who betrays her in pursuit of claiming the throne. She swears to get revenge on him by placing a curse on his daughter, only to find herself developing a maternal bond with the girl. Fantasy adventure based on the story of Sleeping Beauty, starring Angelina Jolie, Elle Fanning, Sharlto Copley and Imelda Staunton.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan arrives in wintry 1961 New York to visit his idol, Woody Guthrie, in self-imposed convalescence at Greystone Park Psychiatric Hospital. An impromptu acoustic performance of a song that Bob has written for Woody propels his star into the ascendancy. Oscar-nominated biopic, starring Timothee Chalamet.

programme.title: 28 Weeks Later
programme.desc: The US military oversees the repopulation of Britain after a virus that turned those infected into bloodthirsty killers finally dies out. Two children sneak away from a London safe zone and make a discovery that threatens to unleash the virus again. Juan Carlos Fresnadillo's horror sequel to 28 Days Later, with Robert Carlyle, Rose Byrne, Jeremy Renner, Imogen Poots and Idris Elba.

programme.title: Alien: Covenant
programme.desc: A crew of colonists sent to populate an alien planet have their mission diverted by a mysterious signal. After landing on a nearby world, they discover what became of the ill-fated Prometheus mission. Ridley Scott's sci-fi thriller, starring Katherine Waterston, Michael Fassbender and Danny McBride.

Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton.

programme.desc: It is the fish course and two chefs, Tommy and Mini, have very similar ingredients - both are cooking mackerel. Chris Archer has chosen the king of the sea, turbot, but there is controversy in the kitchen.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course of the north east region and overnight there has been a dramatic development. It is a tough and emotional day for the chefs as they react to the news but they battle on in a bid to present a perfect dish with venison and wagyu-angus beef - the meat of the day.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is a highly emotional day for one of the chefs as he prepares a dish which is inspired by and a tribute to his own great Briton, his late grandfather. But all is not going to plan and the chef ends up making one key element three times in a bid to achieve perfection.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton for the very first time. Joining them as guest judge is John Williams MBE, the executive head chef at The Ritz, the only hotel to hold a royal warrant for banqueting.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is Chris McGowan's third time however, he is facing tough competition from Mark Abbott, head chef at Daniel Clifford's 2 Michelin star restaurant, Midsummer House, and also from Eddie Attwell who has just completed a year as head chef at Ardtara Country House in Upperlands.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Mark Abbott is pushing himself again plating up a complex fish course of the very finest produce. He is calling it Shellsational but at the last minute he forgets a key element. Returning chef Chris McGowan is refining cod and chips and Eddie Attwell is getting classical with the king of the sea, turbot.The repartee is relentless as the chefs jostle for top place on the leader board. Once again there is plenty of emotion as the veteran chef delivers the scores.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and returning Chef Chris McGowan is feeling confident but part of his dish involves making his own venison sausages to serve with a venison rack, and getting it all done in time is straining his emotions. Eddie Attwell is also serving the meat but with a traditional Northern Irish dish called Dock pudding. Mark Abbott is pushing himself again, he is using wagyu beef and serving it with tongue and corn cooked in a variety of ways.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking their desserts and one chef is on course for a historic score, he could beat his boss - a veteran of GBM - and achieve more marks than anyone has done throughout the history of the competition.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, restaurant critic and Editor-at-Large of the Independent, Amol Rajan.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the national finals of `Great British Menu'. Before cooking starts the eight champions are called to London's Southbank to get a sight of the prize, the chance to cook at a banquet held at the Palace of Westminster, in celebration of everyday Great Britons honoured by the Queen. It has a huge impact on every one of the chefs, each is determined to do all he can to get a dish to the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's day two of the national finals, and the eight champions cook their fish courses. This year's challenge has been to produce dishes that are a lasting legacy to the New Elizabethan Age. They must showcase the transformation in British cuisine during the Queen's historic 64 year reign.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is main course day, the one course every chef wants to cook at the banquet. Judging the chefs' dishes are Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton and guest judge John Williams MBE, executive chef of The Ritz.

Joining them in the judging chamber is Grace Dent, restaurant critic, journalist and author.

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.desc: S16 E34 — Nottingham 2The dealers den descends on Nottingham, where Henry Nicholls gets a grilling over a brooch collection and Fay Rutter sets her sights on a German camera. Plus, a lucky find enables Tim Hogarth to try his hand as an art dealer. David Dickinson hosts.

programme.desc: S16 E16 — Telford 4David Dickinson and the team visit Telford's International Centre, where Stewart Hofgartner makes a big offer for a tiny camera and Tony Geering is tempted by a pair of pricey timepieces.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: S2 E37 — GeorgiaIt's Georgia's turn to take on the Banker - join Stephen Mulhern to find out if she will take home a huge cash prize or become the latest member of the 1p Club.

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: S13 E57Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: BIZ STREAM SPECIAL EDITION
programme.desc: Shoring Up Short-Handed Kitchens: This episode features new services and cooking equipment designed to help restaurants in Japan overcome a deepening labor shortage.

programme.title: JAPAN FROM ABOVE: UP CLOSE
programme.desc: This program takes you on an aerial journey across 21st century Japan. Enjoy the bird's-eye view of unique landscapes as well as intimate portraits of the people who inhabit the archipelago.

programme.title: Journeys in Japan
programme.desc: In Takaoka (Toyama) and Kanazawa (Ishikawa), Kyle Card tastes the influence of the Kitamaebune trading ships.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: My Street Piano
programme.desc: On a shopping street in front of Kagoshima Chuo Station sits Japan' s original street piano, which passersby love to visit and play from the heart.

programme.title: Dining with the Chef
programme.desc: Beat the summer heat with Japanese home cooking! Chef Saito makes juicy chicken wings, glazed with mirin and soy sauce, and serves them with a refreshing zucchini salad. Easy, tasty, and satisfying.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: BIZ STREAM SPECIAL EDITION
programme.desc: Shoring Up Short-Handed Kitchens: This episode features new services and cooking equipment designed to help restaurants in Japan overcome a deepening labor shortage.

programme.title: 1/45: Gambling Addiction
programme.desc: 1 in 45 Japanese are suspected of a gambling addiction. We follow a man who made a clean break from gambling, overcoming the crisis of a broken family, and is in the recovery process from addiction.

programme.title: Document 72 hours
programme.desc: A gold mine in Kagoshima has 190 staff, from teens to veterans in their 60s, who work to extract gold used in jewelry and electronics. Spend three days with people toiling above and belowground.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: MATSURI: The Heartbeat of Japan

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E4Discover the true story of a German Luftwaffe pilot in World War II who risked his own life to save the crew of an American B-17 bomber.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E5This episode tells stories about the secret world of naval deception and cloak and dagger missions. 1914, the yacht Asgard, manned by Erskine Childers, smuggled rifles into a fishing village to arm an Irish militia in their struggle for Home Rule.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E6The 16th century witnessed a revolution in combat ship design and saw the birth of two legendary sea captains; Sir John Hawkins and Sir Francis Drake – both superb seamen and adventurers who would have a lasting impact on naval history.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E2Examining how warfare entered a new dimension as attacks from the skies became possible with weapons from incendiary arrows to drones.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E3Four railway journeys that changed modern history: 24-year-old Winston Churchill boarded an armoured train during the Boer War hoping for a newspaper scoop.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E7A look at key maritime weapons such as the secret super-weapon that kept Constantinople safe for centuries, the thunderous force of a ship's cannon, and the deadly torpedo.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E7The Battle of Leyte Gulf tells the story of the largest sea conflict in history involving Pearl Harbor warships and the largest battleships in the world, and how the US Navy, despite kamikaze attacks and a Japanese decoy fleet, were victorious.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E8In this episode we look at vessels built for amphibious combat. We begin by looking at the last reaming Landing Craft Tank (LCT) to serve on D-Day – LCT 7074. These huge landing craft were essential in delivering tanks, trucks, soldiers and supplies.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E3Weapons experts test the physical and psychological impact of close combat weapons - the Roman short sword, the medieval war hammer and the bayonet.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
